_doc: Final workload suite + status. 'impl' = implemented to the v2 measurement protocol (docs/methodology.md) in src/torch/bench/. Data cells are computed by results/generate_index.py: v2 rows (results/data/v2/<cpu|gpu>/<DEVICE>/<ID>_*.csv, status ok, not smoke) -> 'collected'; sources below (all under results/data/legacy/, frozen) -> 'preliminary', or 'invalid' when valid=false. Optional source key exclude_devices skips listed device dirs. Legacy data is never used in the paper.
plan: Final suite derived from Lee et al., ISCA'10 ('Debunking the 100X GPU vs CPU myth'): every paper kernel that is primarily compute-, bandwidth- or synchronization-bound, plus LLM inference and cryptography. Each workload gets a tuned CPU and a tuned GPU implementation (fastest well-known library, driven from a PyTorch script in src/torch/), run on the same 6-device core matrix.

cpu.note: Grace data lives in results/data/gpu/NVIDIA_GH200_480GB/ (residency_mode=cpu_local rows)

B.name: Bandwidth-bound
B.expect: GPU/CPU ratio tracks the peak DRAM bandwidth ratio

C.name: Compute-bound
C.expect: GPU/CPU ratio tracks the peak FLOP/OP ratio

S.name: Synchronization-bound
S.expect: Ratio below both the BW and FLOP ratios; the CPU can win

A.name: Application (composite)
A.expect: Prefill tracks the FLOP ratio, decode the BW ratio
